scan_degradation.honesty_note: Corrupts the LaserScan stream between the sensor bridge and its consumers. The simulated lidar itself stays healthy: Gazebo Harmonic cannot change SDF sensor noise at runtime.

mobility_fault.honesty_note: An external wrench on the base link, not a degraded actuator. The drivetrain commands joint velocities, so the wrench changes motion only once it exceeds what the wheels can absorb. force_x_n/force_y_n are BODY-frame and are re-projected into the world frame, the only frame ApplyLinkWrench accepts. `activated` means the wrench was published with the gz bridge subscribed; gz acknowledges nothing.

kidnap.honesty_note: Teleports the body. Linear and angular velocity are NOT zeroed, so the robot keeps the twist it had, and z is set by the manager (the scenario schema has no z).

reposition.honesty_note: Moves the body deliberately, and differs from `kidnap` in exactly three ways. (1) The destination is pre-flighted against the committed map with the robot's own footprint and REFUSED if the body would stand in geometry; `kidnap` is deliberately unchecked. (2) Linear and angular velocity are NOT zeroed, so the body keeps the twist it had, and z is set by the manager (the pose carries x/y/yaw only). (3) The estimator is reseeded only on a platform that exposes a seed: the Roomba's AMCL is reseeded through /initialpose, while ArduPilot's EKF3 is not seedable, so on the car nothing is reseeded and the estimate diverges by the teleport distance until GPS pulls it back. Every event says which of the two happened as `estimate_reseeded: true|false`.

spawn.z_source: the 0.06 m wheel radius: base_link's origin is the axle plane, so this puts the tyres on the floor (the hull is offset 0.04 m above it in ral_car/model.sdf)

command.label: GUIDED position setpoint (SET_POSITION_TARGET_LOCAL_NED), waypoints from nav2 planner_server

plant.source: rover_ackermann.parm CRUISE_SPEED/WP_SPEED 1.0; radius is geometric, wheelbase 0.35 / tan(0.52), from ral_description/models/ral_car/model.sdf. TWO MODELLED LIMITATIONS, neither of them corrected: the two knuckles share ArduPilotPlugin channel 0 with identical gains, so the steering is PARALLEL rather than Ackermann (a real linkage turns the inner wheel further than the outer one, and the inner/outer roles swap between a left and a right turn, which a fixed linear offset/multiplier cannot express); and both rear wheels share channel 2, so there is NO DIFFERENTIAL and the inside rear wheel is driven at the same speed as the outside one. Both cost tyre scrub in tight turns, which shows up as lateral slip the estimator must absorb. What they do not change is the property every claim here rests on: the vehicle is non-holonomic, has a finite 0.611 m turning radius and cannot turn in place.

car.scan_note: the only consumer of /scan on this platform is the GLOBAL COSTMAP of nav2's planner_server (config/nav2_car.yaml obstacle_layer, observation_sources: scan). ArduRover's control loop runs on EKF3 alone and has no reactive avoidance, so a degraded lidar can change the ROUTE this vehicle is given and cannot change how it tracks one. MEASURED (runs/scan_degraded_car_20261105T094852Z, the turning route with the degradation active from 57.5 s sim): /scan diverged from /scan_raw on 370 paired sweeps with 0 divergent before activation, and the mission ended mavros:stalled_no_progress 3.03 m from the goal with 1 collision after 3 plan publications - which is how the UNFAULTED turning route ends too (runs/ui_car_20261026T224207Z: stalled, 2.49 m, 2 collisions, 3 plans). The fault reaches the planner's input; no route change has been ISOLATED from this platform's dominant failure, which is tracking accuracy in tight geometry.
car.mobility_note: a body-frame -40 N wrench leaves the mean achieved speed at 0.773 m/s against an unfaulted 0.922 m/s over the same part of the same mission - a 16% deficit, below the 20% this fault is calibrated to - while -80 N reverses it to -0.085 m/s: the body is pushed backwards, the autopilot makes no progress at all (its own estimate moved 0.164 m in 15 s sim), and the mission ends in the runner's deterministic no-progress safe stop.

spawn.z_source: ral_roomba/model.sdf: the wheel centres sit 0.014 below the base centre with radius 0.036, and the caster centres 0.035 below it with radius 0.015, so 0.014 + 0.036 = 0.035 + 0.015 = 0.05 and both touch the floor with the base centre at z 0.05

roomba.mobility_note: MEASURED on this plant at a commanded 0.400 m/s: -15 N and -30 N produce no deficit at all, -60 N produces 25% and pushes the body backwards, -120 N produces 90%.

mission_duration_s.definition: terminal MissionState stamp minus the goal_accepted stamp

path_length_m.source: /ground_truth/odom (frame world) mapped to map by apartment_frames.yaml copied verbatim into env.json
path_length_m.definition: sum of |delta xy| between consecutive truth samples inside the mission window, excluding any step longer than 3.0x this plant maximum (1.0 m/s, from the run's robot profile) for its own dt plus 0.05 m

teleport_excluded_m.source: /ground_truth/odom (frame world) mapped to map by apartment_frames.yaml copied verbatim into env.json
teleport_excluded_m.definition: summed length of the 0 step(s) path_length_m excluded as non-travel (kidnap, respawn or a dropped interval); a measured zero means no such step occurred

goal_pose_error_m.source: /ground_truth/odom mapped to map by apartment_frames.yaml copied verbatim into env.json, against the scenario goal converted the same way
goal_pose_error_m.definition: |last truth sample at or before the terminal stamp, in map, minus the goal in map|

est_error_mean_m.source: /mavros/local_position/odom (ArduPilot EKF3 via MAVROS (LOCAL_POSITION_NED)) paired with /ground_truth/odom by header stamp within 50 ms, truth mapped to map by apartment_frames.yaml copied verbatim into env.json, and the estimate composed from ekf_local into map through the measured world_to_ekf_local in run.json
est_error_mean_m.definition: mean and max |estimate - truth| over the mission window, the estimate being ArduPilot EKF3 via MAVROS (LOCAL_POSITION_NED); each estimate sample is paired with the nearest truth sample by HEADER stamp, and unpaired samples are dropped rather than matched further out; mean over 335 pairs

est_error_max_m.source: /mavros/local_position/odom (ArduPilot EKF3 via MAVROS (LOCAL_POSITION_NED)) paired with /ground_truth/odom by header stamp within 50 ms, truth mapped to map by apartment_frames.yaml copied verbatim into env.json, and the estimate composed from ekf_local into map through the measured world_to_ekf_local in run.json
est_error_max_m.definition: mean and max |estimate - truth| over the mission window, the estimate being ArduPilot EKF3 via MAVROS (LOCAL_POSITION_NED); each estimate sample is paired with the nearest truth sample by HEADER stamp, and unpaired samples are dropped rather than matched further out; max over 335 pairs

est_error_at_start_pose_m.source: /mavros/local_position/odom (ArduPilot EKF3 via MAVROS (LOCAL_POSITION_NED)) paired with /ground_truth/odom by header stamp within 50 ms, truth mapped to map by apartment_frames.yaml copied verbatim into env.json, and the estimate composed from ekf_local into map through the measured world_to_ekf_local in run.json
est_error_at_start_pose_m.definition: mean |estimate - truth| while the robot is at its start pose and rotating in place: from the first /mavros/local_position/odom whose covariance trace is below 0.25 to goal acceptance, excluding any pair whose truth position has already moved more than 0.05 m from the truth position at acceptance. The robot is NOT stationary in this window - AMCL publishes on filter update and its filter updates on motion, so a stopped robot publishes nothing at all; the in-place warm-up rotation leaves xy unchanged, which is what the 0.05 m guard asserts. The guard is applied to the TRUTH half of each pair; within the 50 ms pairing window the body can travel at most 0.050 m, so the bound actually enforced on the estimate half is 0.05 + 0.050 m. It is map error plus world->map alignment error AT THAT ONE POSE, measured, and it is the scale against which in-mission estimate error should be read. It is NOT a lower bound: both terms vary across the map, so in-mission error below this value is normal.
est_error_at_start_pose_m.reason: ArduPilot EKF3 via MAVROS (LOCAL_POSITION_NED) has no operator-triggered initialization to measure from: the estimator sets its own origin at the autopilot's first GPS fix, nothing publishes /initialpose on this platform, and its uncertainty kind is 'estimator_status' rather than a pose covariance whose crossing could open a start-pose window

est_cov_trace_max.definition: max of covariance[0] + covariance[7] + covariance[35] in the window
est_cov_trace_max.reason: ArduPilot does not send LOCAL_POSITION_NED_COV, so /mavros/local_position/* carries no covariance. What this platform's estimator CAN report about itself is its ESTIMATOR_STATUS flags, in est_status_flags - whether they actually arrived on this run is stated in that metric's own reason

est_pos_horiz_accuracy_max_m.definition: max pos_horiz_accuracy and max pos_horiz_ratio over /mavros/estimator_status inside the mission window: the estimator's OWN assessment of its horizontal position accuracy, which is what a platform with no pose covariance can honestly report
est_pos_horiz_accuracy_max_m.reason: /mavros/estimator_status is in the bag and carries no messages

est_status_flags.definition: fraction of /mavros/estimator_status messages inside the mission window in which each ESTIMATOR_STATUS flag was true, plus the message count. The estimator's OWN assessment of which of its states it considers healthy
est_status_flags.reason: /mavros/estimator_status is in the bag and carries no messages

localization_converged_sim_s.definition: first /mavros/local_position/odom whose covariance trace is below 0.25, minus the first /initialpose stamp. AMCL updates its filter on MOTION, so the runner rotates the robot in place while waiting; this measures that wait
localization_converged_sim_s.reason: ArduPilot EKF3 via MAVROS (LOCAL_POSITION_NED) has no operator-triggered initialization to measure from: the estimator sets its own origin at the autopilot's first GPS fix, nothing publishes /initialpose on this platform, and its uncertainty kind is 'estimator_status' rather than a pose covariance whose crossing could open a start-pose window

collision_count.definition: /bumper messages with a non-empty contacts list inside the window, debounced at 0.5 s sim per colliding pair (gz reports a contact every physics step while two bodies touch); 14170 message(s) recorded and 13162 of them carried contacts inside the window, so the contact path is live by its own traffic

plan_publications.definition: count of /plan messages inside the window. On this platform the path comes from the global planner service and is republished by the driver that follows it, so a publication IS a plan or replan; run.json's replan_count records the driver's own count

stopped_time_s.definition: sim seconds inside the window with |linear.x| < 0.01 and |angular.z| < 0.01, zero-order hold on the bag log time (sim), the last command held to the terminal stamp
stopped_time_s.reason: ArduRover is commanded by position setpoint, not velocity; its throttle output is PWM and not a velocity command

mission_result.definition: the terminal MissionState the runner published: its state, its source-prefixed outcome and the topic it was read from. The driver fills the outcome in from the autopilot's own telemetry - mode, armed and wp_dist - never from truth and never from an inference about why the mission ended

recoveries.definition: max number_of_recoveries across NavigateToPose feedback inside the window. Nav2's own count of behaviour-tree recovery executions, never inferred from /plan or /cmd_vel
recoveries.reason: /navigate_to_pose/_action/feedback exists only where a NavigateToPose action server runs; this platform has no behaviour tree and no recovery behaviours to count, whatever it plans with

cmd_vs_achieved.definition: commanded and achieved velocity resampled onto a 10.0 Hz grid over the window and compared sample by sample. Achieved velocity is a central difference of truth POSE, smoothed over 3 samples: forward speed is the body-frame projection of the xy difference on the heading, angular rate is the wrapped yaw difference. The truth message does carry a twist, but it is a raw 50 Hz finite difference stamped on a different grid and is marked unknown (twist.covariance[0] = -1) whenever two poses share a stamp, so it is not used here. The command series is stamped by the recorder and the truth series by the publisher; the measured offset between the two bases in this stack is under 35 ms, against a 100 ms grid step
cmd_vs_achieved.reason: ArduRover is commanded by position setpoint, not velocity; its throttle output is PWM and not a velocity command

speed_vs_target.definition: achieved forward speed on the same 10.0 Hz grid cmd_vs_achieved uses, against 1.0 m/s - the cruise speed this platform is configured with (CRUISE_SPEED/WP_SPEED, recorded in the profile as plant.max_linear_m_s). deficit_fraction is 1 - mean_achieved / target, clamped at 0, so a vehicle at its configured speed reads 0 and a halted one reads 1. after_activation repeats the measurement from the first mobility_fault that reached state=activated to the end of the window, which is the number a mobility fault is read from. ACHIEVED SPEED IS SIMULATOR TRUTH, used here as an evaluation signal: the robot neither measured nor reported it, and no claim is made that it knew it was slow

fault_to_response_s.definition: per FaultEvent that reached state=activated: the first MATERIAL change after it, on a platform with no plan topic, no velocity command and no recovery count. mode_changed = the autopilot's own /mavros/state.mode differing from the mode in force at activation - an EVENT, so it keeps the floor-free comparison; speed_changed = achieved forward speed moving by more than max(0.05 m/s, 1.5x the largest pre-activation excursion), skipped entirely when fewer than two speed samples precede the activation. Earliest wins, and the trigger is recorded. The search is bounded to 2 s sim after activation and the threshold calibrated on the 10 s sim window before it. ACHIEVED SPEED IS SIMULATOR TRUTH, used as an evaluation signal: the autopilot published no velocity of its own to compare against, and no claim is made that the vehicle detected the change
fault_to_response_s.reason: no FaultEvent reached state=activated; states seen: none

obstacle_min_clearance_m.source: /ground_truth/odom mapped to map by apartment_frames.yaml copied verbatim into env.json, against the spawn_obstacle poses run.json records as applied, converted the same way
obstacle_min_clearance_m.definition: smallest (distance from the truth position to the surface of an applied spawned obstacle, minus the footprint radius this robot is scored with) over the interval each obstacle EXISTED - from its activated FaultEvent to its cleared one, or to the end of the mission window. The obstacle is treated as the oriented rectangle it was spawned as; the footprint as a circle of the radius run.json's pre-flight recorded, falling back to the run's robot profile footprint.radius_m. A negative value is penetration
obstacle_min_clearance_m.reason: no spawn_obstacle intervention was applied in this run

scan_degradation_divergence.definition: /scan compared against /scan_raw beam by beam on IDENTICAL header stamps - the relay republishes the sensor's own header, so an exact stamp key is the only join that compares the same sweep. Two ranges are equal when both are +inf or exactly equal; no tolerance, which would hide the injected noise. pairs_divergent_before_activation must be 0 for "the streams differ only after the fault" to hold, and a non-zero value is the measurement rather than an error. pairs_unmatched and pairs_length_mismatch count the sweeps that were NOT compared - no raw entry at that stamp, or a partner with a different beam count - so the denominator behind pairs_compared is reported rather than hidden; a non-zero count means the relay or the recorder dropped sweeps
scan_degradation_divergence.reason: no scan_degradation FaultEvent reached state=activated in this run
